name: Web Animations API Runtime Adapter
summary: Use Web Animations API playback state as a seek-driven adapter for HyperFrames compositions.
problem: Native browser animations can keep advancing independently of the frame timestamp requested by a video renderer.
coreOutcomes: Create Web Animations API effects for composition elements
Set animation current time from the requested composition time
Check repeatable output when seeking between frames
requirements: Browser support for the Web Animations API
boundaries: Covers deterministic playback integration, not broad motion design
Avoid uncontrolled requestAnimationFrame or wall-clock animation loops
